hook.line: A formal notice has to say what the board knows and what it does not. Nobody writes *no sé* on an official letter.
hook.es: Tenemos conocimiento de que la junta pospuso la reunión.
hook.en: We are aware that the board postponed the meeting.

examples.es: Tenemos conocimiento de que se detectaron varios casos.
examples.en: We are aware that several cases were detected.

examples.es: Desconocemos el paradero de los responsables.
examples.en: We do not know the whereabouts of those responsible.

examples.es: Desconozco el resultado de la reunión.
examples.en: I do not know the result of the meeting.

examples.es: Tengo conocimiento de que el decreto cambió.
examples.en: I am aware that the decree changed.

examples.es: Ignoramos qué pasó con el aporte.
examples.en: We do not know what happened to the contribution.

rule:
Formal Spanish has its own ways to say know and don't know.

*Tener conocimiento de que* + a full sentence = *to be aware that*: *Tenemos conocimiento de que…*
*Desconocer* + a thing = *not to know it*: *Desconocemos el motivo.* With *yo*: *desconozco*.
*Ignorar* here also means *not to know*: *Lo ignoro*, *ignoramos qué pasó*.

Watch out: *ignorar* is not *to ignore someone*. In a formal text it means you lack the information.
smallPrint: Teachers call this the language of formal (un)awareness, with *ignorar* as a false friend.

readAndPick.es: Desconocemos el motivo de la decisión.
options: We know the reason for the decision.
We do not know the reason for the decision.

readAndPick.es: Tenemos conocimiento de que la junta pospuso la reunión.
options: We are aware that the board postponed the meeting.
We are not aware that the board postponed the meeting.

readAndPick.es: Desconozco el resultado de la reunión.
options: We do not know the result of the meeting.
I do not know the result of the meeting.

readAndPick.es: Tengo conocimiento de que el decreto cambió.
options: We are aware that the decree changed.
I am aware that the decree changed.

readAndPick.es: Ignoramos qué pasó con el aporte.
options: We know what happened to the contribution.
We do not know what happened to the contribution.
We do not know whether the regulation changed.
We know that the regulation changed.
Are you (formal) aware of the resolution?
Is he aware of the resolution?

yourTurn.prompt: Choose *Tenemos* or *Desconocemos*, then type the whole sentence: ___ conocimiento de que la junta pospuso la reunión. (We are aware that…)
yourTurn.answer: Tenemos conocimiento de que la junta pospuso la reunión.
yourTurn.why: *Tener conocimiento de que* means to be aware, so *tenemos* fits.

yourTurn.prompt: Choose *desconozco* or *desconocemos*, then type the whole sentence: Yo ___ el resultado de la reunión. (I do not know)
yourTurn.answer: Desconozco el resultado de la reunión.

yourTurn.prompt: Type it in Spanish: We do not know the date of the meeting.
yourTurn.answer: Desconocemos la fecha de la reunión.
yourTurn.why: *Desconocemos* takes the thing you do not know straight after it.

yourTurn.prompt: Type it in Spanish: I do not know. (formal, short)
yourTurn.why: *Ignorar* here is to not know, and *lo* stands for the matter.

yourTurn.prompt: Type it in Spanish: We do not know the reason for the decision.
yourTurn.answer: Desconocemos el motivo de la decisión.
yourTurn.why: Same verb, a different thing you do not know.

yourTurn.prompt: Make it about *I*: Tenemos conocimiento de que el decreto cambió.
yourTurn.answer: Tengo conocimiento de que el decreto cambió.

yourTurn.prompt: Type it in Spanish: We do not know the whereabouts of the associate.

pitfalls.wrong: Tenemos conocimiento que se detectaron varios casos.
pitfalls.right: Tenemos conocimiento de que se detectaron varios casos.
pitfalls.why: Almost. The phrase is *conocimiento de que*, with *de*.

pitfalls.wrong: Desconozcemos el motivo de la decisión.
pitfalls.right: Desconocemos el motivo de la decisión.

personal: Write one formal sentence about something you do not know today, with *desconozco* or *lo ignoro*.
